title: What do strong market sizing answers look like across 24 worked examples?
description: Twenty-four market sizing questions, from coffee cups to hotel rooms, each with a step-by-step worked answer and sanity check.
hook: The fastest way to get good at market sizing is to see lots of worked examples, then try your own. Here are twenty-four, from coffee cups to hotel rooms, each with a full worked answer.
body:
Start with the market sizing guide if you have not already, then work through these. Try each one before you read the answer.

Good first questions

  • How many cups of coffee do London cafés sell on a weekday? About 3.38M cups a day.
  • What do people in the UK spend on umbrellas each year? About £227M a year.
  • How many full-time wedding photographers does the UK need? About 10k photographers.
  • What is the yearly revenue of one busy London coffee shop? About £630k a year.
  • How many car tyres are sold in the UK each year? About 33M tyres a year.
  • How many toothbrushes and brush heads are bought in the US each year? About 1.34B a year.
  • What do UK cinemas take at the box office each year? About £979M a year.
  • How many litres of bottled water does the UK drink each year? About 2.72B litres a year.
  • How many laptops do UK university students buy each year? About 967k laptops a year.
  • How many delivery pizzas are ordered in the UK each week? About 7.14M pizzas a week.
  • What do UK families spend on school uniforms each year? About £2B a year.

A step up

  • How many hairdressers work in London? About 25.6k hairdressers.
  • How big is the US market for dog food each year? About $37.1B a year.
  • How many smartphones are sold in India each year? About 175M phones a year.
  • How big is the UK gym membership market each year? About £4.28B a year.
  • How many piano tuners work in Chicago? About 54 piano tuners.
  • How many parcels are delivered to UK homes each year? About 2.91B parcels a year.
  • How many office chairs do UK employers buy each year? About 2.14M chairs a year.
  • What is the yearly revenue of all car washes in the US? About $13.1B a year.
  • How many ride-hailing trips are taken in London each day? About 405k trips a day.
  • How many home EV chargers are installed in the UK each year? About 192k chargers a year.

Harder ones

  • How many dentists does the UK need? About 36.1k dentists.
  • How many passengers fly from or to Heathrow on an average day? About 187k passengers a day.
  • How many hotel rooms are there in Paris? About 114k rooms.
